doc.title: Bernie Kirsh interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 27, 2022

title: Mixing live sound on the road with Chick
summary: What it was like to set up in each venue and run sound for Chick's band.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Oh it’s lovely and it caught my attention and it came from this, which we’ll talk about soon. That’s wonderful. I wondered what being on the road with Chick is like. You get in a venue and go okay what do we have today?
Well of course they were all different — each one has its — they all have the same components it’s just different problems to solve. You know because I’m coming at it

from a technical point of view when I walk into the venue, sound-wise. Things have to be set up and connected and all that kind of stuff. Get ready for the sound check is basically it, and that’s when the musicians show up. But yeah, they all have their own problems. I really enjoyed the live sound mixing that I did with Chick. It was — there was nothing to think about. Just — they played on stage and I got to make it sound the way I liked it to sound. It was a real playground.
You have had a great gig.
